scanners.postScanningSessionsSetup.description: Makes the zones, events, staff, sessions and devices for a set of doors in one batch. Send an `Idempotency-Key`: the same key and body replays the answer with `replayed: true` and no PINs or pairing codes (codes that ran out are reissued, `pairingReissued: true`); the same key with another body is 409 `SCAN_SETUP_KEY_REUSED`. PINs and pairing codes appear once. `?dryRun=true` returns the plan and its checks with refs in place of ids and writes nothing. Any `error` check is 422 `SCAN_SETUP_CHECKS_FAILED`. `dryRun` needs no key and runs the same rules. A `scanning:write` key makes places (live) and devices with no pairing code; staff and pairing codes need `scanning:admin`.
